source.title: Walker - Wildland Outlaw
source.name: Walker
source.description: A steadfast Rogue who undertakes the bounties of the mightiest enemies and defeats them.

skills.name: Six-Shot

description.raw: Walker loads his revolver with 6 bullets, randomly shooting at enemies in front, prioritizing enemies not hit during this cast. Each bullet deals 50% (ATK-based) damage plus 5% + 1% (SP-based) of the target's max HP (the bonus damage is up to 60% (ATK-based)), stunning the target for 1.5 + 0.2 (SP-based)s. Subsequent hits on the same target deal 50% damage.
active: Walker loads his revolver with 6 bullets, randomly shooting at enemies in front, prioritizing enemies not hit during this cast.
Each bullet deals 50% (ATK-based) damage plus 5% + 1% (SP-based) of the target's max HP (the bonus damage is up to 60% (ATK-based)), stunning the target for 1.5 + 0.2 (SP-based)s.
Subsequent hits on the same target deal 50% damage.

text: Unlocks at level 51: When the enemies in front include a target marked with Bounty Pursuit, the remaining bullets will be directed at the targeted enemy after shooting all others.
Unlocks at level 111: Increases damage to 55% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at level 171: Increases damage to 60% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at level 231: Increases stun duration to 2 + 0.2 (SP-based)s.

skills.description_lite: Walker fires at enemies in front one by one after loading bullets, dealing damage and stunning them.

skills.name: Shotgun Blast

description.raw: Walker shoots 3 penetrative bullets using normal attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the frontal area. His main target will always receive damage from 3 bullets, each with 34% (ATK-based) + 6% (SP-based) damage. Walker's normal attack range cannot be buffed any further.
active: Walker shoots 3 penetrative bullets using normal attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the frontal area.
His main target will always receive damage from 3 bullets, each with 34% (ATK-based) + 6% (SP-based) damage.
Walker's normal attack range cannot be buffed any further.

text: Unlocks at level 71: Walker's normal attacks stun enemies for 0.125s upon dealing critical hits.
Unlocks at level 131: Increases each bullet's damage dealt to 37% (ATK-based) + 6% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 191: Increases each bullet's damage dealt to 40% (ATK-based) + 6% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Walker's normal attacks are enhanced to cause AoE damage.

skills.name: Bounty Pursuit

description.raw: Walker claims the bounty on the enemy with the highest accumulated damage dealt 10s after a battle starts. Walker prioritizes attacking this enemy upon claiming the bounty, increasing his damage dealt by 25% + 5% (SP-based) and reducing his damage taken by 18% + 5% (SP-based). Walker gains 5 + 3 (SP-based) Crit Boost (up to 15 + 9 (SP-based)) till the battle ends when the targeted enemy is defeated.
active: Walker claims the bounty on the enemy with the highest accumulated damage dealt 10s after a battle starts.
Walker prioritizes attacking this enemy upon claiming the bounty, increasing his damage dealt by 25% + 5% (SP-based) and reducing his damage taken by 18% + 5% (SP-based).
Walker gains 5 + 3 (SP-based) Crit Boost (up to 15 + 9 (SP-based)) till the battle ends when the targeted enemy is defeated.

text: Unlocks at level 91: Upon claiming the bounty, Walker fires 3 shots at the enemy who is marked with it.
Each shot deals 50% (ATK-based) damage plus the damage equal to 4% of the target's lost HP (the bonus damage is up to 25% (ATK-based)).
Unlocks at level 151: Walker can claim the bounty again after the previous targeted enemy is defeated.
Unlocks at level 211: Upon claiming the bounty, Walker fires 3 shots at the enemy who is marked with it.
Each shot deals 55% (ATK-based) damage plus the damage equal to 4% of the target's lost HP (the bonus damage is up to 25% (ATK-based)).

skills.description_lite: Walker prioritizes attacking the enemy with the highest accumulated damage dealt, during which he gains a buff.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Increases Crit DMG Boost by 30 during battle.
active: Increases Crit DMG Boost by 30 during battle.

text: Increases Crit DMG Boost by 40 during battle.
Increases Crit DMG Boost by 50 during battle.

skills.description_lite: Increases Crit DMG Boost during battle.

skills.name: Aerial Thunder

description.raw: Walker throws a grenade at each of the 3 enemies when a battle starts, then uses his revolver to detonate the grenade. The enemies within a 1-tile arc will be stunned for 2s, taking 140% (ATK-based) damage and losing 10% Phys DEF in 15s upon grenades exploding. The above skill effect only takes effect once when multiple grenades hit the same target.
active: Walker throws a grenade at each of the 3 enemies when a battle starts, then uses his revolver to detonate the grenade.
The enemies within a 1-tile arc will be stunned for 2s, taking 140% (ATK-based) damage and losing 10% Phys DEF in 15s upon grenades exploding.
The above skill effect only takes effect once when multiple grenades hit the same target.

text: Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 5: Reduces the enemies' Crit Resist by 10 in 15s.
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 10: Increases damage to 150%.
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 15: Increases damage to 160%.

skills.description_lite: Walker throws grenades at the beginning of a battle, dealing AoE damage and stunning his enemies.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Walker gains a shield equal to 20% of max HP when dealing damage to the targeted enemy for the first time. This shield lasts till the target is defeated.
active: Walker gains a shield equal to 20% of max HP when dealing damage to the targeted enemy for the first time.
This shield lasts till the target is defeated.

skills.description_lite: Walker gains a shield when dealing damage to the bounty target for the first time.
